description: 80-dps proton-pinned diagnostic measurement of the qou-m45w remainder: evaluates T2 and T3 in binding_block_multiplicative / binding_via_interface_knot under Convention-D per-generator V_hat^D (Arms D1a/D1b) and Convention-D interleaved nucleon block Markov traces trP, trN + Markov interface scalars (Arms D2a/D2b and whole-word D3) vs the hybrid normalized_plancherel baseline on main (Arm P0), isolating exact Phi_q / Li_2^q poles at z = +q0 (qou-2tuv).
caveats: Diagnostic measurement only; zero fitting. Both single-crossing chain interfaces (excluded by ChainBondOrderDependence and superseded by the 2026-11-15 gamma-gamma bond ruling) and non-extensive trace/dilog differences (LogFormUniqueness) are recorded solely to answer the qou-m45w / qou-2tuv diagnostic.
